arms.instruction: Improve the pinned solver using the visible development instances and shared tools. You may construct experiments and conditional strategies autonomously. Preserve feasibility, objective semantics and truthful statuses.

Improve the pinned solver using the visible diverse development population and shared tools. You may construct experiments and conditional strategies autonomously. Preserve feasibility, objective semantics and truthful statuses.

Improve the pinned solver with the same diverse population and tools. Before benchmarking each nonempty candidate patch, register its mechanism, applicable conditions, algorithm-state features, failure hypotheses, correctness invariants and a controlled falsification experiment with pitbench hypothesis --plan FILE. Select the registered experiment using pitbench bench --hypothesis-id ID --experiment-id ID. Adaptation may use algorithm state and observable input features; do not branch on hidden identities or reference answers. Retain failed and rejected candidates.

inference_scope: One fresh independent Agent start per task/model/arm. Judge instance/solver-seed intervals describe the realized patch, not Agent-generation variance. Diversity is assessed with B-A; the mechanism intervention with C-B. Versions within a repository and distributions within a task are dependent, not independent software tasks. No best-of-model, best-of-arm or outcome-selected test panels.
